ZBH.thesis_one_line: A big maker of hip and knee replacements and surgical robots, priced as if it will never grow, while it raises guidance and buys back stock.
kill_criteria: Organic constant-currency revenue growth below 2.0% in two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: 4.0%; guide "2.25% - 3.25%").
FY26 adjusted-EPS guidance cut below the "$8.47" low end, or an FY27 guide midpoint under $8.47 (no growth).
Consolidated net debt / TTM GAAP EBITDA above 3.5x (3.1x at 30 Jun 2026); covenant is 4.5x.
No permanent CFO announced by 31 Dec 2026.
Knee organic growth negative for three consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: +0.1%).
key_adverse_facts: Knee organic growth was +0.1% in Q2 2026 (H1 +0.9%); adjusted EPS was flat year over year at $2.07.
CFO resigned effective 28 Apr 2026 (interim since); Group President departing 30 Sep 2026; APAC president replaced.
Consolidated net debt $7,069.0m is about 3.1x TTM GAAP EBITDA, with $571.5m (Dec 2026) and $600.0m (Feb 2027) notes due; covenant 4.5x.
IRS proposed adjustments for 2013-2019, China distributor claims with unestimable loss, litigation accrual $137.9m; about $30m of H1 2026 cost relief came from a one-time IEEPA tariff refund.
data_conflicts: Triage Q07 called ZBH a value trap with weak quality; filings show real cash conversion (TTM FCF about $1.2bn, 1.49x GAAP net earnings) but low growth, so cheap for a reason rather than mispriced.
Headline 10.7x adjusted P/E vs 22x GAAP P/E: adjusted EPS excludes about $0.67 a quarter of acquired-intangible amortisation.

confidence_in_thesis.reason: Price-implied growth (0.8%) is far below base (5%) and cash conversion is verified, but knee growth is stagnant, finance leadership is unsettled and leverage is 3.1x.

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 9% with TTM FCF $1.2bn implies 0.8% a year of 10-year growth (1.9% after SBC) versus my 5% base; the discount is explained by low organic growth and leadership risk.

ZBH.scenario_basis: Start FY2026E adjusted EPS $8.53 (guide midpoint $8.47-$8.59); EPS CAGR 0%/6%/9% to FY2029; exit adjusted P/E 8.5x/12x/14x; dividends $0.96 a share a year growing 3%; price $91.04 at 25 Sep 2026.

UNH.thesis_one_line: America's largest health insurer and care-services group is repairing profits after a bad 2025, but open Justice Department probes and a shrinking book cap what to pay.
kill_criteria: A criminal charge or civil complaint against UNH or an Optum unit on Medicare Advantage coding, or any DOJ settlement or penalty above $3bn.
FY2026 adjusted-EPS guidance cut below the "$19.50" low end at the October 2026 or later releases.
UnitedHealthcare people served below 47.0m at 31 Dec 2026 (48.5m at 30 Jun 2026), or Medicare Advantage below 7.2m (7.565m).
Reported medical care ratio above 91.0% in Q3 or Q4 2026 (Q2: 86.7%; guide "88.1% ± 25 bps" implies about 90–91% in H2).
key_adverse_facts: 8-K of 24 Jul 2025: company is complying with formal criminal and civil DOJ requests about Medicare programme participation; 2017 False Claims Act case unresolved.
IRS Notices of Proposed Adjustment (6 Mar 2026) on 2017-2020 transfer pricing seek to 'significantly increase taxable income'; no amount disclosed.
Revenue flat (+0.4% in Q2 2026); UnitedHealthcare people served 48.5m vs 50.1m a year earlier; MA members down 965k since year-end 2025.

Q2 2026 medical care ratio 86.7% includes $860m net favorable prior-period development; FY guide of 88.1% implies about 90-91% in H2. FY2025 GAAP EPS of $13.23 missed the October 2025 outlook of at least $14.90.
data_conflicts: Triage Q08 cited an 'ongoing DOJ investigation'; filings confirm formal criminal and civil requests (8-K acc. 0000731766-25-000224) but the 10-K and 10-Q give no scope or amount.
Cash-flow statement shows $1,646m of H1 2026 buybacks while the equity statement shows $3,728m, and the release says $4.0bn through mid-July; settlement timing, not reconciled in the filings.
Vendor NTM EPS $22.6 (16.7x) is well above company FY2026 adjusted guide midpoint $19.75 (19.1x); I use company guidance.

confidence_in_thesis.reason: Recovery is visible in guidance raises, but earnings quality (reserve releases), a shrinking book and unresolved DOJ and IRS matters leave wide outcomes; base return about 6% a year.

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 9% on guided net earnings of $16.75bn implies 5.1% a year versus my 6.3% base (in line to above at a 10% discount rate), but the stock trades at a premium to ELV, CI and CVS and the base three-year return is only about 6% a year, so the verdict is WATCH.

UNH.scenario_basis: Start FY2026E adjusted EPS $19.75 (guide $19.50-$20.00); EPS CAGR 0%/8%/12% to FY2029; exit adjusted P/E 12.5x/17x/19x; dividends $9.28 a share a year growing 3%; price $376.59 at 25 Sep 2026.

WST.thesis_one_line: Supplier of the rubber seals and syringe parts inside injectable medicines, growing fast with net cash, but priced for far more growth than I can justify.
kill_criteria: Organic net sales growth below 6.0% in two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: 12.7%; Q3 guide "7.0% to 8.9%").
HVP Components organic growth below 8% in two consecutive quarters (Q2 2026: +18.4%).
FY2026 adjusted-EPS guidance cut below the "$8.85" low end, or disclosure of loss or a cut above 25% in orders from the top customer (15.8% of 2025 sales).
TTM FCF (operating cash flow less capex) below 60% of TTM GAAP net income at the Q4 2026 release (77% today).
A new material cybersecurity incident, or litigation accrual above $50m.
key_adverse_facts: Price $370.44 is 41x FY2026 adjusted EPS guide midpoint with a 1.7% TTM FCF yield; implied 10-year FCF growth about 17% vs my 11% base.
Material cybersecurity attack in May 2026 (8-K Item 1.05, acc. 0000105770-26-000068): data exfiltrated, systems encrypted; operations later 'fully recovered'; claims not yet quantified.
Top customer was 15.8% ($485.9m) and top ten 47.6% of 2025 sales; 10-K names oral GLP-1s and dosing changes as risks.
CEO handover effective 31 Aug 2026; securities class action (class period Feb 2023-Feb 2025) pending; H1 2026 operating cash flow down 30% and receivables up 24%.
data_conflicts: Q2 2026 release 'Second-Quarter Summary' reports operating cash flow $213.9m, capex $85.9m and FCF $128.0m, which equal the six-month 10-Q figures; true Q2 is about $124.0m, $43.2m and $80.8m (derived from Q1 release $89.9m and $42.7m).
Triage Q07 said price was the only issue; filings add the cyber incident, CEO change and litigation.

confidence_in_thesis.reason: Business quality and beat-and-raise record are verified from filings; the valuation conclusion is robust across 8-10% discount rates because even the bull case is below the implied growth.

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No V1 row exists. Reverse DCF at 9% implies 17.1% a year of 10-year FCF growth (normalised $520m base) versus my 11% base and 14% bull, so a great business is priced for more than it can deliver.

WST.scenario_basis: Start FY2026E adjusted EPS $8.95 (guide $8.85-$9.05); EPS CAGR 6%/12%/15% to FY2029; exit adjusted P/E 24x/32x/38x; dividends $0.88 a share a year growing 3%; price $370.44 at 25 Sep 2026.
